thread.title: Apple post-earnings decline set to cost the Dow some 90 points at open

author: Stocks News Feed
title: Apple post-earnings decline set to cost the Dow some 90 points at open
text:
Shares of Apple Inc.
 AAPL, -5.77%
 tumbled 5.8% in premarket trade, after fiscal fourth-quarter results beat expectations, but the technology giant spooked investors by saying it will no longer disclose unit sales . The stock ’s price decline would shave about 88 points off the Dow Jones Industrial Average’s
 DJIA, +0.50%
 price, while Dow futures
 YMZ8, +0.42%
 rose 166 points.
